name: auto-editor
description: Local rough cuts for talking-head and screen recordings: remove silence or accelerate pauses while preserving speech speed.

interface.shortDescription: Remove silence and shorten pauses in local video rough cuts
interface.longDescription: Analyze audio levels locally with Auto-Editor to remove silence or accelerate pauses while keeping speech at normal speed. Preserve source files, preview cut statistics, and produce rough cuts for talking-head videos, lessons, and screen recordings. Protect meaningful screen activity without narration. Requires the official Auto-Editor CLI; no account or MCP connection is needed.
defaultPrompt: Remove silence from this talking-head video, preserving natural breaths and the original file.
Speed up pauses in this screen recording by 4x while keeping speech at normal speed.
Analyze how much silence can be removed from this video without exporting yet.
